name: master-key
description: Unify credential master key creation and preserve damaged keys
validation: Primary source review and 6 isolated secrets tests passed, including concurrent creation, damaged-key preservation and authenticated encryption. No user credential files read.

name: http-boundary
description: Constrain HTTP file resolution and preserve encoded filenames (#Q-0528)
validation: Primary review and 4 HTTP regression tests passed outside the sandbox: Windows path traversal, special filenames, fragmented loopback requests and temporary junction escape. Sandbox denies sockets/junction creation, so initial sandbox failure was rerun with required access.

name: markdown-association
description: Correct Markdown association registry rights and error propagation
validation: Compiled with the main lib test binary; primary review verified KEY_READ|KEY_WRITE and all open/read/delete failure branches. Real file associations intentionally not changed.

name: receiver-ci
description: Check and test the standalone certificate receiver in CI
validation: Primary workflow review: receiver check/test explicitly target its separate manifest, all hard Cargo checks use --locked. Receiver tests are also run locally during final acceptance.

name: toolchain-docs
description: Align development prerequisites and port documentation with CI
validation: Cross-checked package.json engines, CI Node22/pnpm11, release Rust1.93, Vite8 and Tauri devUrl port8888. Documentation diff reviewed.
